description: Assembly source code for a MIPS-based bootloader segment that performs initialization, relocation, cache management, BSS clearing, stack setup, and jumps to the main loader routine. It is specific to the LZMA-compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards within the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Main entry point for the assembly startup routine that initializes CPU state, relocates code, manages cache, clears BSS segment, sets up the stack, and jumps to the loader main routine.
